title: Street Light Ko Andhera Kaise Pata Chalta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Street light shaam hote hi apne aap kaise jal jaati hai? Na koi timer, na koi insaan, bas ek chhota sa LDR!
💡 LDR light sensor kya hota hai
📉 Din aur raat mein resistance kaise badalta hai
🔌 Comparator, transistor aur relay ka poora chain
🔁 Hysteresis kya hai aur flicker kyun rukta hai
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karo!
#shorts #ldr #streetlight #electronics #hindi #howitworks
